description: List a character's attachment points — the bone anchors an object can be pinned to (hands, head, back, waist…). Call this before studio_attach_object: point names and indices are fixed, but which ones actually exist depends on the character's rig, and attaching to a point whose bone is missing would silently leave the object floating at the scene root. Only points with 'available': true can be used.

index.description: point index, 1..54; pass it (or 'name') as studio_attach_object's 'attach_point'

name.description: point name, e.g. 'N_Hand_L' or 'N_Head_top'; accepted by studio_attach_object in place of the index

available.description: the point resolves to a real bone on this character. **false means unusable** — the point node exists on every rig, but attaching to one without a bone orphans the object while still reporting success

attached.description: ids of the objects currently attached to this point
